items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-20
items.q: Who did you play over there mostly with? Pinky and Pete and Al Herrick... And Pete and Al Herg.

ctx.x: Or the name of the dance hall?
It was probably Burgundy Street. It wasn't where Pete was. Pete was on Royal. He was at Lusitannis, huh? He was on Royal Street.
Yeah, that's the old Lusitannis, isn't it? I don't know.
